title: LocalAppCatalog schema bundle
description: JSON Schema bundle for every file under data/. Addressed by $id so each def can be compiled independently.

packageId.title: Android package id
packageId.description: An Android package id: a lowercase first segment, then one or more dot-separated segments. All-lowercase is only a convention - real store listings carry uppercase inside later segments (com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping, com.bKash.customerapp, com.sbi.SBIFreedomPlus, in.gov.ecourts.eCourtsServices, br.com.buscape.MainPack), and a lowercase-only pattern would reject genuine apps, which is the one thing this catalog cannot afford.

category.title: Category slug
category.description: Must also be listed in data/index.json#categories, which is the registry that makes categories extensible.

confidence.title: Provenance confidence
confidence.description: verified = maintainer-confirmed against a live store listing in the declared country. community = submitted by a contributor, not yet confirmed. legacy = previously verified, store listing or package no longer resolves; kept for history but excluded from bundles.

added_by.description: GitHub-style handle of the contributor who added the entry.

evidence.description: Store or official URL that demonstrates the app belongs to this country. Reachable from that country.

store.description: Optional id of the store adapter that can confirm this package (google_play, cafe_bazaar, rustore, appgallery, myket, apkpure, onestore, fdroid).

verified_at.description: Date of the most recent successful store availability check. Required for confidence=verified.

index.title: data/index.json - the registry that defines which countries and categories exist

version.description: Data format version. Independent of the release tag (vYYYY.MM.DD).

globalFile.title: data/global.json - packages that are deliberately NOT local to any country
globalFile.description: Negative catalog. A package listed here must never appear in a per-country catalog file; that is what keeps global confusables out of split-tunnel bypass sets.
